newsitem.title: USA: Aon unit acquires German broker.
newsitem.headline: Aon unit acquires German broker.

text.p: Aon Group Inc, an insurance brokerage unit of Aon Corp, said Tuesday its German subsidiary, HAVAG/Hudig-Langeveldt GmbH, acquired the German insurance brokerage organization, Wesselhoeft Ahlers & Schues OHG. Terms were not disclosed.
Wesselhoeft Ahlers will be combined with Aon Group's Germany operations, headquartered in Hamburg. It will consist of 500 employees serving clients from 14 offices throughout Germany.

While both companies are commercial insurance brokers and consultants, HVAG/Hudig-Langeveldt specializes in freight forwarders' liability and provides insurance brokerage services for international construction companies and for the fine arts.
Wesselhoeft Ahlers offers a range of specialist insurance services, including credit-insurance expertise, and insurance services to Japanese clients.
